maya: quick follow-up after today's partial-response spike during scale-up. root cause likely: client handshake/backoff mismatch + transient queueing on cold workers. proposed short list of actions below, pls pick owners.
aj: i'll take reconnect + SDK changes. will add jittered exp backoff, tighten handshake timeout to 3s, and add explicit PartialChunk error. target: draft PR by Tue EOD.
simon: i'll tune server timeouts and add a per-session inflight cap (canary tonight = 6). need AJ's sim to reproduce.
liz: i'll add dashboards: metrics = partial_chunk_rate, handshake_fail_rate, inflight_per_session_p95. alert if partial_chunk_rate > 0.3% for 10m. ETA: Wed.
priya: i'll update postmortem and runbook with disable-streaming fallback and oncall steps. weekly check-ins for 3 weeks.
incident-bot: created STREAM-4901 (sdk-reconnect), STREAM-4902 (server-timeouts), STREAM-4903 (telemetry), STREAM-4904 (runbook).
maya: owners/deadlines: aj PR Tue; simon canary tonight; liz dashboards Wed; priya runbook Mon. pls attach PR links & test logs to tickets.
